"""Inject only the local language resource and localized outgoing display text."""
import re

MARKER = '<script id="ua-art-site-languages" src="/video/ua-site-languages.js?v=site-ge-002-v1" defer></script>'


def inject_html(source):
    if not isinstance(source, str) or not re.search(r'<html\b', source, re.I):
        return source
    if 'id="ua-art-site-languages"' not in source:
        source, count = re.subn(r'</head\s*>', MARKER + '\n</head>', source, count=1, flags=re.I)
        if count != 1:
            raise ValueError('SITE_GE_HEAD_MISSING')
    # Translate only native share's existing human-readable text, preserving identity,
    # price, URL and the original native/fallback behavior.
    needle = ";try{if(navigator.share)"
    addition = ";if(window.UAArtLocale){d.text=window.UAArtLocale.t(d.text);}try{if(navigator.share)"
    source = source.replace(needle, addition)
    # The selection form keeps its original data-k/data-t values and CRM payload.
    # Translate the composed WhatsApp display text before URI encoding.
    pattern = r'(  function tekstom\(\)\{.*?)(   return s;)(\n  \})'
    source = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: m[1] + '   return window.UAArtLocale ? window.UAArtLocale.message(s) : s;' + m[3], source, count=1, flags=re.S)
    old = "tekstom()+'Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.'"
    new = "tekstom()+(window.UAArtLocale?window.UAArtLocale.t('Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.'):'Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.')"
    source = source.replace(old, new)
    source = source.replace('(Показано|Показанo|Показано:|Показуємо|Показано авто)', '(Показано|Показанo|Показано:|Показуємо|Показано авто|ნაჩვენებია)')
    return source


def normalize_patch(source):
    """Reverse exactly our changes for byte-for-byte unrelated-content checks."""
    source = source.replace(MARKER + '\n', '').replace(MARKER, '')
    source = source.replace(';if(window.UAArtLocale){d.text=window.UAArtLocale.t(d.text);}try{if(navigator.share)', ';try{if(navigator.share)')
    source = source.replace('   return window.UAArtLocale ? window.UAArtLocale.message(s) : s;', '   return s;')
    source = source.replace("tekstom()+(window.UAArtLocale?window.UAArtLocale.t('Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.'):'Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.')", "tekstom()+'Прикрепляю фото машины, которую хочу.'")
    source = source.replace('(Показано|Показанo|Показано:|Показуємо|Показано авто|ნაჩვენებია)', '(Показано|Показанo|Показано:|Показуємо|Показано авто)')
    return source

# UA-PRICE-HTML-V2: single CRM source for generated market prices.
_ua_price_base_inject = inject_html
def inject_html(source):
    from ua_price_html_v2 import render
    return render(_ua_price_base_inject(source))

def slug(value):
    return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', value.lower()).strip('-')


def model_name(key):
    return '%s %s' % key


def path(lang, key=None):
    if key == ORDER:
        name = ORDER_SLUG[lang]
    elif key == JAPAN:
        name = JAPAN_SLUG[lang]
    elif key == PRICE:
        name = PRICE_SLUG[lang]
    elif key in order_models.TOPICS:  # SEO-CONTENT-001
        name = order_models.TOPICS[key][lang]['slug']
    else:
        name = HUB[lang] if key is None else '%s-%s-%s' % (slug(key[0]), slug(key[1]), MODEL_SUFFIX[lang])
    return 'seo/%s/%s.html' % (DIRS[lang], name)


def url(relative):
    return '%s/video/%s' % (ORIGIN, relative)


def money(value):
    return '{:,}'.format(value).replace(',', ' ')


def _years(cars):
    years = sorted({int(m.group(0)) for c in cars for m in [re.search(r'(19|20)[0-9]{2}$', c['name'])] if m})
    if not years:
        return ''
    return str(years[0]) if years[0] == years[-1] else '%d–%d' % (years[0], years[-1])


def _prices(cars):
    prices = [c['price_usd'] for c in cars if c.get('price_usd')]
    return (money(min(prices)), money(max(prices))) if prices else (None, None)


def _alternates(key, existing):
    links = [(lang, path(lang, key)) for lang in LANGS]
    ka = 'seo/gu/%s.html' % (HUB['ka'] if key is None else '%s-%s-%s' % (slug(key[0]), slug(key[1]), MODEL_SUFFIX['ka']))
    if ka in existing and key not in (ORDER, JAPAN, PRICE):
        links.append(('ka', ka))
    links.append(('x-default', path('uk', key)))
    return ''.join('<link rel="alternate" hreflang="%s" href="%s">' % (lang, url(rel)) for lang, rel in links)


def _car_list(cars, lang):
    t = T[lang]
    items = []
    for i, c in enumerate(cars):
        stage = STAGES.get(c.get('stage'))
        details = ' · '.join(x for x in (
            ('%s %s' % (money(c['mileage_km']), t['km'])) if c.get('mileage_km') is not None else '',
            stage[LANGS.index(lang)] if stage else '') if x)
        image = ('<img src="%s" alt="%s" loading="%s" decoding="async">' % (
            escape(c['image']), escape(c['name']), 'eager' if i == 0 else 'lazy')) if c.get('image') else ''
        price = '<span class="price">%s $</span>' % money(c['price_usd']) if c.get('price_usd') else ''
        items.append('<li><a href="%s">%s<div><b>%s</b>%s<span class="muted">%s</span></div></a></li>' % (
            escape(c['url']), image, escape(c['name']), price, escape(details)))
    return '<ul class="cars">%s</ul>' % ''.join(items)


def _model_links(groups, lang, current=None):
    t = T[lang]
    items = []
    for key in sorted(groups):
        if key == current:
            continue
        low = _prices(groups[key])[0]
        label = model_name(key) + (' — ' + t['from_price'].format(min=low) if low else '')
        items.append('<li><a href="/video/%s">%s</a></li>' % (path(lang, key), escape(label)))
    return '<ul class="models">%s</ul>' % ''.join(items) if items else ''

def _budgets(cars, lang):
    t = T[lang]
    bounds = (0,) + BUDGETS + (None,)
    items = []
    for since, to in zip(bounds, bounds[1:]):
        group = [c for c in cars if c.get('price_usd') and c['price_usd'] >= since and (to is None or c['price_usd'] < to)]
        if not group:
            continue
        label = (t['budget_up'].format(to=money(to)) if not since else
                 t['budget_from'].format(since=money(since)) if to is None else
                 t['budget_mid'].format(since=money(since), to=money(to)))
        names = ', '.join(sorted({model_name(c['key']) for c in group if c.get('key')}))
        items.append('<li><b>%s</b> — %s%s</li>' % (escape(label), escape(t['count'].format(n=len(group))),
                                                   (': ' + escape(names)) if names else ''))
    return '<ul>%s</ul>' % ''.join(items) if items else ''
